svg.title: HomeBrain Climate Motherboard
svg.text: HOMEBRAIN CLIMATE MOTHERBOARD — V1.2-DRAFT DIRECT-SOLDER ASSEMBLY
One dedicated PCB • factory male headers solder through labeled footprints • no inter-module wire harnesses
THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS ARE COPPER TRACES
Colored routes are visualization only; the finished assembly contains no loose sensor wiring.
U1 XIAO: factory 1x7 headers plus rigid BAT-/BAT+ posts through XB1/XB2; solder underside, inspect, trim.
vertical; insert factory-installed 1x3 male header through J1, solder from the motherboard underside,
inspect, then trim; blue sensor rises from the board and printed + OUT - faces inward
solder the verified mating pigtail directly into BAT+ and BAT- holes; its factory connector remains
Before U1 installation, solder saved resistor-lead posts to XIAO BAT−/BAT+; guide through XB1/XB2 and solder underside.
Four 3.4 mm grounded mounting holes accept common #4 screws into printed plastic posts.
